items.title: Marshall Lawrence Interview, 1960-06-28
items.q: He used to book different bands. Joe Robichaux and our band and some other bands.

ctx.x: That couldn't have been Banzi, huh? No. Not Banzi for you.
He used to book different bands. Joe Robichaux and our band and some other bands.
Well, we'll ask Joe Robichaux about it. You don't know.
